Below it a darker lower mass (rows 21-31, L about 27-46) acts as the shaded front face. The silhouette widens from 4 at row 10 to 29 at row 26, then narrows to 8 at row 31. It has no separate side face.

answer.evidence: The bush is a lobed mound. Its width grows from 4 at row 10 to 25 at rows 16-18 and reaches 29 at row 26, then narrows to 8 at row 31. Rows 10-19 are the light lime and green top lobes (#b0cc58, #6ea03a), which read as foliage seen from above. Below them, rows 20-31 shift to dark green and near-black (L 27-68), which reads as the shaded south face and underside. The change from lit top to dark front is clear at rows 19-22, though there is no crisp 1-row edge line. The top is a rounded heap rather than a flat plane, so this is a moderately confident three_quarter reading. There is no flat-slab or pure front-elevation look.
